create_policy_value: create a PolicyValue instance to compute the value of a specified strategy given a game, distribution, and policy
eval_state: eval the value of a game state using backward pass through chance, mean field, and player nodes
evaluate: evaluate the value over all root states of the policy using recursive backward induction
value: retrieve the computed value of a state, optionally including a specific action's contribution
review_policy_value: review the PolicyValue class that extends ValueFunction and implements backward pass for mean-field game policy evaluation
